It reported 'Farhan -> Rafizi' correctly FOR THAT WINDOW. I then asked the owner about the TIMESTAMP 2:51:13 and applied their correct answer ('Rafizi') to the BLOCK, deleting a different speaker's turn 26 seconds later. My frame sample at the block midpoint landed inside the two-shot the owner's own note predicts.

THREE FIXES, all of them mine to make: this restore; the stamp corrected to 2:51:41 so the block's window and its words agree; and a drift guard in audit_block_attribution.py so no block whose stamp disagrees with its text can be acted on again.

THE PROCESS LESSON: an owner decision lived only in a commit message. It belongs HERE. Read git log for prior owner findings before touching an episode, and never ask about a second when the change will be applied to a block.
